verdict.rationale: cfo.ai records every change to the Model in a changelog under the user's name, and every write, including agent and Ari edits, can be undone. That gives review and rollback of what automated work changes. It does not show versioning of the automations themselves, such as alert triggers or sync schedules. Missing for 10: versioning of automation or trigger definitions, diff and review of automation configs before they run, rollback of automation settings (not just Model writes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Every change to the Model, such as a formula, a Table block, or a Page edit, is recorded in the Model's changelog under the user's name and can be undone.
Every write is undoable, and anything it cannot verify it declines to sign.
